description: Social post saying a named person's loan is 'already approved'.
content:
Congratulations Alex! Your $15,000 ClearPath loan is already approved and waiting for you. Tap to claim it.

Rates 8.99%-35.99% APR. Terms apply.
notes: Approval language without an application or a prescreen. Without the phrase 'pre-approved' a regex misses it. UDAAP-GUARANTEE could also be argued; reviewers may differ, so only FCRA-PREQUAL is expected.
